subject: English
passage: It has long been accepted that the extinction of dinosaurs occurred gradually over millions of years due to climate change and competition with mammals. ______ based on analysis of iridium deposits found in rock layers worldwide, scientists recently proposed that dinosaurs disappeared suddenly 66 million years ago due to an asteroid impact—much more rapidly than previously believed.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. "However" logically signals that the theory discussed in this sentence—that dinosaurs disappeared suddenly due to an asteroid impact—contrasts with the previously discussed theory that extinction occurred gradually over millions of years.
